spans.text: **Provenance per claim**: every node and edge carries which source produced it. No claims without sources.
spans.note: The prompt strongly emphasizes provenance tracking, source attribution, and de-duplication discipline. Every claim must carry its source, and the system explicitly avoids fabricating synthesis claims. Partial dossiers are marked as truncated rather than presented as complete.

spans.text: **De-dup, don't merge**: when two sources name the same entity, link both as separate sources on one node; don't fabricate a synthesis claim.

spans.text: Type-detect: file path, code symbol, username/handle, URL, ADR-id, or free-text concept.
spans.note: The prompt instructs the system to recursively investigate entities including usernames/handles, perform web searches on people, fetch profile pages, run git blame to identify authors, and build dossiers — all without any mention of user consent, privacy safeguards, data minimization, or restrictions on collecting personal information. This is a significant privacy concern as it could be used to build surveillance profiles on individuals.
